subject: general
question:
**Match the following:**

 
 

 Substance
 pH
 
 
 
 

 i. Human body
 a. less than 5.6
 
 

 ii. Acid rain
 less than 5.5 b.
 
 

 iii. When tooth decay begins in the mouth
 c. 7 to 7.8
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: i-c, ii-a, iii-b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The pH of the human body is slightly alkaline, ranging from **7 to 7.8** (i-c).
 
• Acid rain has a pH of **less than 5.6** (ii-a).
 
• Tooth decay begins in the mouth when the pH is **less than 5.5** (iii-b).
 
• The correct matching leads to the conclusion that Option 2 is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **pH Scale:**

 
 
• The pH scale measures how acidic or basic a substance is on a scale of 0 to 14.
 
• A pH less than 7 indicates acidity, while a pH greater than 7 indicates alkalinity.
 
• A pH of 7 is considered neutral, which is the pH of pure water.
 
 
 
• **Human Body pH:**
 
 
• The human body maintains a slightly alkaline pH, typically between 7.35 and 7.45, which is crucial for various physiological processes.
 
 
 
• **Acid Rain:**
 
 
• Acid rain occurs when sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) are released into the atmosphere and react with water, oxygen, and other chemicals to form sulfuric and nitric acids.
 
• These acids then mix with rainwater, lowering its pH to below 5.6, which can harm ecosystems, buildings, and human health.
 
 
 
• **Tooth Decay and pH:**
 
 
• Tooth decay occurs when the pH in the mouth drops below 5.5, leading to the demineralization of tooth enamel.
 
• This acidic environment is often a result of bacterial metabolism of sugars present in food, producing acids that lower the pH.
